column2: Earned MILE is divided by party size

Run together with CPU allies (up to 3). Allies fight automatically and come back a little while after going down. MILE is divided by the total number of party members, including you and your CPU allies. You receive only your share. Runs with support are excluded from rankings (unlocks and personal bests work as usual).

Blaze through cleared sections and start running just before the gate you chose. Boss reward cards are picked for you at random. Match each ring's height (every 5,000m, upper or lower) to choose 1 extra card. You earn no MILE for the skipped distance. On arrival, you start running with your player level raised according to the distance reached.
